# Modeling Epidemics with Julia {.unnumbered}

This executable course develops mathematical models from their assumptions and equations through simulation, inference, and decision-making in Julia.

The course supports a mixed audience:

- Optional prerequisites introduce Julia, probability, calculus, and numerical methods.
- Twelve core chapters progress from the SIR model to a complete data-to-decision case study.
- Nine advanced appendices extend the same modeling ideas to delays, scientific machine learning, probabilistic numerics, control, and model composition.

Every teaching unit has a detailed book chapter, a Reveal.js slide deck, an interactive Pluto notebook, and two exercises with solutions.

Start with [Setting up](setup.qmd) to install Julia, VS Code, Quarto, and the course packages.

Workshop participants: see the [workshop resources](resources.qmd) for the
chapter, slides, and worksheet of each taught session. Every other chapter links
its own slides and notebook at the end of the page.
